newsitem.title: USA: Aetna names Retirement Services head.
newsitem.headline: Aetna names Retirement Services head.

text.p: Life and health insurer Aetna Inc. said Monday that Thomas McInerney, 41, has been named president of its Retirement Services unit.
McInerney succeeds Daniel Kearney, 58, who announced his retirement on Monday. Kearney will remain as a consultant until February 1998, the company said in a release.
Retirement Services is one of Aetna's three main businesses, along with Aetna U.S. Healthcare and Aetna International.
Aetna said that McInerney was a corporate planner who had a key role in Aetna's $4.1-billion sale of its property-casualty business to Travelers Group Inc in April 1996.
He also helped plan Aetna's $8.9-billion merger with U.S. Healthcare last July, the company said. McInerney will report to Aetna Inc. President and Chief Executive Richard Huber.
McInerney was previously head of corporate strategy for Aetna. He joined the company in 1978.
